prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production-ready transparent game HUD texture for a small growth-experience bonus badge in a cozy kitten game.
Primary request: one single horizontal rounded capsule badge, front view, plump inflated 3D form with clearly visible depth and broad glossy highlight, visually related to luxury jelly-heart game UI but quieter.
Scene/backdrop: true transparent background outside the object, no scene.
Subject: a blank, wide capsule, about 3:1 width-to-height, centered with minimal transparent breathing room. Both ends are smoothly hemispherical, no pointed ends.
Materials and palette: a pale warm ivory / vanilla-cream central face for highly readable dark text; a translucent pale pistachio-green glass-jelly outer rim; one thin champagne-gold edge catching warm light. Noticeable rounded sidewall thickness along the lower edge. Rich tactile 3D shading, rounded soft bevels, subtle internal refraction at the edges. Broad soft white-cream highlight across the upper third, without washing out the rim.
Composition: perfectly horizontal and symmetrical, camera almost orthographic straight-on. The central 75 percent stays blank and calm for live HTML Chinese text plus a multiplier. The physical capsule itself must be wide and full, not a thin line or outline.
Lighting: warm room light from upper left; soft restrained attached shadow only, enough depth to read at a tiny 85 by 30 CSS-pixel size.
Text: none. Absolutely no letters, words, numbers, glyphs, logo, lock, heart, icon, watermark, extra objects, decorative stars, loose sparkles, rays, particles, frame, mockup or checkerboard. No busy patterns. One standalone blank pill only. Preserve actual transparency.
